scope_limits: New authenticated companion native controls are Wine/private LAN, including controlled TCP+UDP INPUT source mapping. No new Internet/ISP/CGNAT/topology assurance from them. Prior N1/Internet prototype evidence retains its own scope.

New authenticated transport on actual Internet remains an explicit M8 deployment/packaging measurement under the existing phase1 Internet target; do not infer it from the old raw-relay prototype. No retroactive K6c/K7 dependency.

Real QUIC negatives run the production Hub/Bridge/router with real SQLite and sockets under isolated loopback. Native KR supplies positive compatibility/gameplay controls; it does not author forged authenticated packets.

Restart native run reloads exact quiescent DB bytes after an orderly stopped service; network/PID namespaces recreated. No account resume, match restore, kill-crash consistency, rollback or full backup/restore acceptance.
Loopback proxy does not authenticate another local process. Per-session endpoint quarantine has finite budget and fails closed; no automatic reconnect or unbounded session claim.
Native59 fault remains unresolved; native8 follow-up did not repeat it. M8 counts client faults and reopens bounded caller/input trace if repeated. No fix claim.

native.environment: Isolated Wine pair, separate endpoint namespaces; shared TCP/UDP source via INPUT SNAT. No NAT filtering/mapping-type or PMTU claim; no configured delay/jitter/loss/reordering/bandwidth/MTU change.
